instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a martial arts gym with grey padded walls, the shirtless man with a mullet (R2) on the left and the man in the black t-shirt (R1) on the right spar. The man in the black t-shirt (R1) balances on one leg to deliver a high right kick. The shirtless man (R2) lifts his left knee to block the incoming kick, holding his white boxing gloves up defensively. Both wear protective white shin guards and glasses. The background is clear of bystanders. Neutral overhead gym lighting illuminates the grey floor mats.
